On the assessor map, the Kittyhawk edge of lot 28 carries a ditto mark that chains to the explicit '55' printed on lot 27's Kittyhawk edge. This is consistent with the tract map.

uncertainties: The situs address (7137 Kittyhawk Ave) is not printed on either map and cannot be verified from the images.
On the assessor map, lot 28's dimensions are shown only by ditto marks; the depth 125 is printed explicitly only on lot 27. The values are therefore taken from the recorded tract map (303-18).

The assessor map labels 'TRACT ... 303' near lots 29-30 and '11569' near lot 13. The tract identity for lot 28 is cross-checked on tract sheets labeled 'TRACT No 11569', recorded in Map Book 303, pages 17-20. That recording reference is distinct from the assessor map ID.
The derived area is a geometric calculation, not a printed area, and does not account for any easements or later adjustments.

frontage.reason: The assessor map's north arrow points straight up. Kittyhawk Ave runs diagonally from lower-left to upper-right (northeast-southwest), and lot 28 lies on its upper-left (northwest) side, between the alley and Kittyhawk. On tract sheet 2 the Kittyhawk edge of lot 28 runs along N.43°08'34"E, and the side lines run N.46°51'26"W. The lot therefore fronts its southeast edge onto Kittyhawk Avenue. The alley is the rear (northwest) boundary.
